subtitle: Your Journey, Your Way

days.title: ARRIVAL - WELCOME TO YOUR DESTINATION
days.description: Arrival at the airport. Meet & greet and private transfer to your hotel. Check-in and relax. Evening free for leisure or local exploration.

days.title: CITY TOUR & LOCAL ATTRACTIONS
days.description: After breakfast, enjoy a guided city tour covering the top attractions, local culture, and scenic spots. Evening free for shopping or leisure.

days.title: ISLAND TOUR & WATER ACTIVITIES
days.description: Enjoy a full-day island tour with breathtaking views, beaches, and exciting water activities. Lunch included during the tour.

days.title: NATURE & CULTURAL EXPERIENCE
days.description: Visit beautiful natural and cultural sites. Experience the local traditions, temples, and viewpoints. Evening at leisure.

days.title: LEISURE DAY
days.description: Day free for you to relax, explore on your own, or enjoy optional activities.

days.title: DEPARTURE
days.description: After breakfast, check-out from the hotel. Private transfer to the airport for your return journey with wonderful memories.
